column2: The Savoy and Nice Mission Closes

The ambassador can no longer carry out the territorial instructions. Changes in government, sovereignty or the relations between the courts have deprived the unfinished negotiation of its basis. The ministry closes the dossier and returns the unused appropriation. A fresh mission must be authorised if the required circumstances return.
Close the unfinished mission and reconcile its accounts.

The fighting has ended without an accepted territorial settlement. No province passes by this armistice, and neither cabinet can present it as the fulfilment of the national demands. The Italian ministry retains the unresolved correspondence. Any renewed campaign must respect the peace and the engagements now binding the crown.
Record the unresolved dispute and respect the peace.
